_comment: T9 = the accepted stack A1-A5 + A7 + A8 + A9. Exactly ONE key differs from rounds/T8_A8_dedup_clear/policy.json: on_low_similarity_cross_container. A9 is ALSO env-gated (ANCHOROPT_XCM=1); both the policy flag and the env var must be set, which is why an arm shard that forgets the export runs as a control and scores identically to it -- that exact signature is how the v1/v2 delivery defect was eventually caught.
